name: Plugins
why: A plugin, from its source to the skill text it adds to a start
ideal: Every plugin has a verified listing or an official equivalent, loads in seconds and adds a short skill listing.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Plugin security and trust

steps.name: Source
steps.rule: Every plugin on is official, verified or the repo's own.

steps.name: Skip
steps.rule: A thread skips no plugin or server it cannot load.

steps.name: Load
steps.rule: The plugin sets load within three seconds.

steps.name: Keep
steps.rule: Only skill names and descriptions load up front; bodies wait for use.

steps.name: Clean
steps.rule: No install is left off, delisted or abandoned.
